items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 130:1
items.html: (To the question) What is slumber? The ascent of the MAN of ZA to Aba and Ima is discerned for ZA in his place as being in the secret of slumber, which means the departure of the Mochin, like a man in the time of sleep. See above in Answer 121. (Item 93).
